units.source_text: 他在东京闹市区长大，对歌舞伎和日本舞自幼耳濡目染，暗记了一些长歌的歌词，自然就听会了。

en.t: He grew up in a busy district of Tokyo, and from childhood he had absorbed kabuki and Japanese dance, memorizing some nagauta lyrics, so he naturally learned to understand it by ear.
He had never studied it himself.

units.source_text: 提起长歌，立即联想到舞蹈的舞台，而不是艺妓的筵席。

en.t: When he thought of nagauta, he immediately imagined a dance stage, not a geisha banquet room.
